messages:
alex: Heads-up security advisory — found a leaked GitHub PAT in an archived repo. High risk, treat immediately. Creating incident INC-2025-47. :rotating_light:
maria: Ack. Which scopes?
alex: repo + admin:org. Issued to CI account ci-deploy-prod. Exposure ~72h.
jake: Immediate actions from ops runbook:
- Revoke PAT in GitHub org settings
- Rotate CI service account creds + update Actions secrets
- Invalidate active sessions for related principals
- Audit recent deploys and quarantine unknowns

priya: I'll revoke in GitHub and rotate secrets now.

ops-oncall: Launched scan task and quarantine for suspect deploys. Link: https://internal.re/redwood/incidents/INC-2025-47
sre-bot: Incident INC-2025-47 created (P1). Pager alert sent.
maria: Checklist to follow exactly:
1) Revoke the PAT and post token id (do NOT paste token)
2) Rotate CI keys and update GitHub Actions secrets
3) Force re-auth for long-lived sessions
4) Run `scripts/check_leaked_tokens.sh --org redwood`
5) Ensure org admins have MFA enforced
6) Post proof of rotation (screenshot or redacted commit)

alex: 48h deadline for completion. Escalate to me if blocked. 7-day audit follow-up.

priya: Revoked PAT id ghp_XXXXXXX at 2025-11-02T14:08Z. Updating secrets.
jake: Running scanner & disabling old AWS keys for ci-deploy-prod:
```
aws iam list-access-keys --user-name ci-deploy-prod
aws iam update-access-key --user-name ci-deploy-prod --access-key-id <ID> --status Inactive
```
New keys will go to Vault once GitHub secrets updated.

ops-oncall: Scanner flagged 3 deploys; 2 known pipeline, 1 from `unknown-bot`. Quarantined that release and rolled back to previous stable tag.
maria: Also rotate any GCP SA keys used by CI; use `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create` and set rotation policy.

priya: GitHub Actions secret CI_TOKEN replaced, PR: https://github.com/redwood/workflows/pull/289 (secret redacted).
jake: AWS creds rotated, sessions revoked, uploaded to Vault with least-privilege. Proof: redwood/infra#712 updated secrets-rotation.md (redacted).
maria: Leak scanner shows no other matches. Added alert rule for PATs with admin:org scope.

ops-oncall: Rollback health checks are green.
alex: Good work. Security will run a 30-min postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Policy action: block PAT creation with admin:org unless approved. Invite infra, devex, platform, legal.

priya: I'll join.
jake: Noted.
maria: Preparing EO and slides.
alex: Keep updates here. If anything new shows up, ping @alex and mark incident reopened. :lock:
